rules.name: unused-output
rules.description: A block has outputs that nothing reads.

rules.name: missing-input
rules.description: A required input has no source.

rules.name: lock-and-refresh
rules.description: A block is locked and also marked always-refetch.

rules.name: overlapping-parts
rules.description: Two parts of the same block overlap in time.

rules.name: dynamic-not-fixed
rules.description: A dynamic block is neither baked nor locked, so results can change between builds.

rules.name: pinned-outdated
rules.description: A pinned block uses an older version than its template.

rules.name: no-path-to-master
rules.description: A block that makes audio never reaches the master.

rules.name: name-case-clash
rules.description: Two block names differ only by upper or lower case.

rules.name: custom-seed
rules.description: A block uses custom seeds instead of derived ones.

rules.name: older-port-name
rules.description: A connection uses an older internal port name (in, out, mix, in3, render_in) instead of the name of the stream it carries (audio, notes, render, audio1); v1 only reads the stream names. ample migrate renames them.

rules.name: pre-release-header
rules.description: A block header uses the pre-release form class@version (stable@1.1, live@0.4); v1 leaves the class and the number out and only a pinned block states pinned@<version>. ample migrate converts the song.
